# jontstaz profile README

Self-hosted, watermark-free GitHub profile cards. Everything you see on
https://github.com/jontstaz is generated by `generate.py` from **live
GitHub data** (GraphQL: contribution calendar, repos, language bytes) and
regenerated daily by GitHub Actions — no third-party services, no
watermarks.

## How it works

- `generate.py` — pulls data with `gh api graphql`, computes streaks /
  language mix / top repos, downloads the avatar and pixelates it with
  Pillow, then writes five SVG cards into the repo root.
- `hero.svg` — "SIGNAL RUN": the real contribution grid with a pixel ship
  flying over it, animated stat blocks and language power-up chips.
- `pilot.svg` — neofetch-style terminal card: pixel-art portrait with CRT
  scanlines, identity fields, stats strip, blinking caret.
- `missions.svg` — top repositories by stars (rows are links).
- `langs.svg` — language mix bars from actual language byte counts.
- `flight.svg` — 26-week weekly commit bar chart + streak telemetry.
- `.github/workflows/regen.yml` — daily cron (03:30 UTC), commits
  regenerated SVGs as `github-actions[bot]`.

## Local usage

```bash
# requires: gh CLI authenticated as jontstaz, python3 + Pillow
python3 generate.py
```

Preview any card locally (animations show in a browser, rsvg shows the
final frame):

```bash
rsvg-convert -w 1200 hero.svg -o hero.png   # or just open the .svg
```

## GitHub-SVG constraints (respect these when editing)

- No `<script>`, no external images/fetches — GitHub's camo proxy strips
  them. Data URI images (the pixel portrait) and SMIL `<animate>` /
  `<animateTransform>` are fine.
- Avoid CSS `animation` with `opacity:0` start states: SVG renderers
  without CSS animation support (camo caches, some clients) would show
  blank cards. Use `animation: ... both` (not `forwards`) or bake final
  state + SMIL `<animate fill="freeze">` instead.
- Animations run on loop in browsers; static renderers show the baked
  state — design both to look right.
